description: After entering keyboard navigation on a horizontal dock, Left and Right move focus and clamp at both ends; unsupported Home/End safely keep the current focus.

assertions.comment: Entering through the actual focus-dock QAction slot enables keyboard navigation; the Meta+F5 key binding itself is not verified outside a KGlobalAccel environment.
Entering keyboard navigation focuses the first launcher.
The first DockItem focus-ring child path is visible.
The first keyboard-focused icon zooms to the default MaxZoomFactor of 1.6.
Pressing Right moves focus to the second item.
After moving with Right, the first item focus ring is cleared.

Home is unsupported in the current implementation and keeps focus on the second item without an exception. Marked invariant: the assertion is that focus does not move past the end. The discriminator is QA-KEY-002 in this same run, where the same key does move focus one item.

End is also unsupported in the current implementation and keeps focus on the second item without an exception. Marked invariant: the assertion is that focus does not move past the end. The discriminator is QA-KEY-002 in this same run, where the same key does move focus one item.
Pressing Left returns focus from the second item to the first.

Further Left presses on the first item stay on the first item without wrap-around. Marked invariant: the assertion is that focus does not move past the end. The discriminator is QA-KEY-002 in this same run, where the same key does move focus one item.

Further Right presses on the last item stay on the last item. Marked invariant: the assertion is that focus does not move past the end. The discriminator is QA-KEY-002 in this same run, where the same key does move focus one item.
